refund.title: Refund & Withdrawal Policy
refund.intro: Mochi is prepaid credit usable only in one creator's market, granted as a bonus when you donate to them. Order cancellations and withdrawal of a donation are handled as set out below.

seller.title: Who sells, and who holds the money
seller.body: Each creator sells the items in their own market. Your donation passes through a licensed PG directly to the creator, and motoo does not hold the funds. Mochi is granted as a bonus for that donation, not sold. motoo provides the marketplace as an intermediary, and the refund obligation sits with the creator as seller. motoo receives requests and assists with processing.

orderCancel.title: 1. Order cancellation — returned as mochi
orderCancel.body: If a creator cancels an order you placed for a market item, the mochi spent on that order is restored to your balance in full. This is a return of mochi, not a cash refund.
orderCancel.note: Instant items complete at the moment of ordering, so they cannot be cancelled.

withdrawal.title: 2. Withdrawal of a donation — within 7 days
withdrawal.body: If it is within 7 days of your donation and you have not spent a single mochi earned from it, you may withdraw it. The full amount you donated is returned to your original payment method.
withdrawal.note: If any mochi earned from that donation has been spent, withdrawal no longer applies. The remaining mochi stays usable in the creator's market.

legalException.title: 3. Refunds required by law
legalException.body: Separately from the above, where the law requires a refund we process it accordingly. A payment made by a minor without their legal guardian's consent is the principal example.

howTo.title: 4. How to request
howTo.body: Contact support. We confirm your donation history and the grounds for the request, tell you the outcome, and — where a withdrawal is confirmed — return the payment within the statutory 3 business days. Depending on your payment method, the money may take a few days more to appear.

noResale.title: 5. Transfer and resale
noResale.body: Mochi cannot be transferred or resold to anyone else, and cannot be moved between creators. Refunds are made only to the person who donated.
